name: Retail net flow — weekly (est. total)
notes: Quote-midpoint classifier (§5.1): identifies ~1/3 of retail trades. Gated 'uncalibrated' until RF9 >= 0.6 (§7.2). SCALED x3.0 to estimated TOTAL retail (identified floor x 3.0; factor from the BHJOS ~1/3 capture rate, confirmed vs ~20% consensus participation; provisional until RF9 fits it empirically). Unscaled floor = shown value / 3.0. Weekly sum of midpoint-signed daily net flow; weeks with <3 signed days omitted. NOTE: no official retail NET flow series exists (FINRA OTC data is unsigned volume) — this is our estimate at weekly cadence. Daily granularity: RF1D.

series.name: Weekly est. total retail net flow ($B)
